import io.xberg.literllm.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var reqJson = "{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"You are a helpful assistant.\",\"role\":\"system\"},{\"content\":\"What is the weather in Paris?\",\"role\":\"user\"},{\"content\":null,\"role\":\"assistant\",\"tool_calls\":[{\"function\":{\"arguments\":\"{\\\"location\\\": \\\"Paris, France\\\"}\",\"name\":\"get_weather\"},\"id\":\"call_xyz789\",\"type\":\"function\"}]},{\"content\":\"{\\\"temperature\\\": 18, \\\"unit\\\": \\\"celsius\\\", \\\"description\\\": \\\"Partly cloudy\\\"}\",\"role\":\"tool\",\"tool_call_id\":\"call_xyz789\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\"}";
        var req = JsonUtil.fromJson(reqJson, ChatCompletionRequest.class);
        var apiKey = System.getenv("API_KEY");
        if (apiKey == null || apiKey.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalStateException("API_KEY must be set");
        try (var client = LiterLlm.createClient(apiKey, null, null, null, null)) {
        var result = client.chat(req);
        System.out.println(result.choices());
        System.out.println(result.choices().get(0).finishReason());
        }
    }
}
